answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 31726 Country: Pakistan Title: I kept Ummama name on my daughter, please tell me about the meaning and tell me about the name. Question: I kept Ummama name on my daughter, please tell me about the meaning and tell me about the name. Answer ID: 31726 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 993/549/D=1432) Umama was the name of the granddaughter of the holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم). It is enough for the blessing and honour of this name. In such names, there is no importance of literal meaning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
